doc: Defines QNFO (the Quniverse): the portfolio of products built on the Ultrastable platform. Ultrastable core is NOT part of QNFO; qnfo-workers holds its pilot copy until each core worker is deployed from github.com/ultrastable/workers into the ultrastable Cloudflare account (see platform.migration). scripts/qnfo_portfolio.mjs fails when a live worker is in no product, in two, or disagrees with product/boundary.json.

platform.name: Ultrastable
platform.qnfo_is: tenant zero: runs on the platform through product/tenant.example.json settings and the policy overlay, owns no kernel code
platform.migration: each core worker leaves qnfo-workers (RETIRED marker plus fleet delete) only after the same worker answers /health from the ultrastable account; until then boundary.json class core marks the pilot copy
contract: canonical deploy with probes and revert

managers: Program managers (QNFO.OPS, INFRA, REACH, RSCH, PERSONAL) are platform personas; each product below names the program that manages it.

qnfo-research.what: autonomous research: ideas, papers, PDFs, patents, library Q&A

qnfo-reach.what: distribution: social, mail, subscribers, lifecycle, shorts

q08-personal.what: the owner's private companion, memory and job search; never shipped, never crosses into research stores

signals-to-value.what: signal scraping, essays and forecasts turned into scored predictions

qwav.what: quantum computing landing page and demos; served by qnfo-gateway, no worker of its own

fleet-console.what: fleet.qnfo.org operator console: the platform's UI as QNFO uses it. Core worker qnfo-fleet-dashboard still serves research pages; those split out when the console moves to the ultrastable account
